answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8318 Country: India Title: What is the sunnath of applying surma, 1. Can we apply it any time (i.e., morning, evening, while going to function, office etc) plz reply. Question: Assalaamu Alaikum W R: What is the sunnath of applying surma, 1. Can we apply it any time (i.e., morning, evening, while going to function, office etc) plz reply. Jazakallah. Answer ID: 8318 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1828/D=114/K=1429) The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to apply surma (kohl) at bed time thrice in each eye. (Khasail Nabwi) This is the sunnah way of applying kohl. It is allowed to apply at other occasions as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
